items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: The third trumpet player that we had with us, who was really a second trumpet player, Joe Keyes

ctx.x: And, who was the other trumpet player, I don't know. But we had a -- I had a sad awakening, after coming back to Paris, with Sissle in 1930.
The third trumpet player that we had with us, who was really a second trumpet player, Joe Keyes -- you heard of him?
